portals.name: SEC

portals.name: SCM
portals.scope: Suppliers, procurement, inventory, demand forecasting and logistics

portals.name: HRM

capabilityAssessment.name: Security
capabilityAssessment.evidence: Identity, trust, verification and safety services exist; enterprise RBAC, tenant isolation and centralized secret policy still need hardening.

capabilityAssessment.name: Agentic AI
capabilityAssessment.evidence: Registry, workflow, brain, ML integration and connector execution exist; durable delegation contracts and autonomous recovery policy need expansion.

capabilityAssessment.name: Governance
capabilityAssessment.evidence: Policy evaluation, audit trail and ledger anchoring are implemented; durable human-approval records are the next required control.

capabilityAssessment.name: Diagnostics
capabilityAssessment.evidence: Health endpoints and console health-map exist; full tracing, SLOs and alert routing are not yet complete.

capabilityAssessment.name: Analytics
capabilityAssessment.evidence: Cost optimiser, brain reliability and audit data exist; unified token, cost, success-rate and agent KPI dashboards are still incomplete.

capabilityAssessment.name: Orchestration
capabilityAssessment.evidence: Workflow service and governed connector execution exist; checkpointing, compensation and multi-agent retry strategy need deeper implementation.

capabilityAssessment.name: Topology
capabilityAssessment.evidence: Service health and connector catalogue expose topology inputs; dependency graph visualization is present while runtime dependency discovery remains limited.

capabilityAssessment.name: Administration
capabilityAssessment.evidence: No complete enterprise tenant/user administration plane is present yet; identity and registry provide foundations.

capabilityAssessment.name: SCM
capabilityAssessment.evidence: First-class SCM domain registry, connector affinity, capability metadata and domain-bound execution are implemented on master.

capabilityAssessment.name: HRM
capabilityAssessment.evidence: First-class HRM domain registry, connector affinity, sensitive-data classes and approval-required operations are implemented on master.
